rationale.edition: Every changed path lives under web/src/** (the OSS frontend) plus scripts/translations/** — none are under enterprise-owned locations such as enterprise/ or o2_enterprise/. No enterprise-only keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/cipher/logo-management) appear in the changed paths or symbols; this is the core OSS ingestion 'first event' onboarding flow, so edition is 'oss'.
rationale.skip: No skip applies. The trigger comment and feature hint are empty (no 'skip' opt-out or tests-added label), and the change is not docs/CI-only — it alters the user-facing ingestion first-event status bar with a new skeleton 'deciding' state, new idle states, resume-across-reload behavior, and config-tool naming in the invalid-credentials fix.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the change adds a visible loading state (skeleton while a target watch decides), changes the idle copy ('Checks start when you copy the command/config'), changes which snippet a config guide re-copies (copySnippet first/last), and names the config tool in the invalid-credentials fix — all user-exercisable UI behavior reachable from the stream ingestion flow.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI changes live in web/src/components/ingestion/** (FirstEventStatus, IngestionContent, and the per-tool config guides) plus the firstEvent composables. No 'Ingestion' Playwright folder exists; the closest sibling specs are in Streams, which already holds ingestion-config.spec.js covering this same ingestion config surface.
rationale.group: The Streams shard in the ci-matrix already carries ingestion-config.spec.js (present in the cloud/env/firefox/scheduled matrices), so the new spec belongs on the same shard to run against the same ingestion config surface this feature extends.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The changed *.spec.ts files (FirstEventStatus.spec.ts, IngestionContent.spec.ts, configGuides.spec.ts, useFirstDataNotice.spec.ts, useFirstEventWatch.spec.ts) are Vitest unit tests under web/src — not E2E coverage — so there is no existing E2E coverage to enhance.
